title: The `podman quadlet list` command is missing the `--quiet` option
body:
### Feature request description

Most of our listing commands have a `--quiet` option but `podman quadlet list` does not.

### Suggest potential solution

Add a `--quiet` option to `podman quadlet list` that prints just the names of each quadlet, one per line.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

N/A

### Additional context

N/A
